skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: (No energy consumed) Deals damage to enemies in a row with 3 consecutive strikes for 900% ATK, grants 30% Block Rate to all allies for 2 rounds.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: (No energy consumed) Deals damage to enemies in a row with 3 consecutive strikes for 900% > 1200% ATK, grants 30% > 40% Block Rate to all allies for 2 rounds.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gain 60% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. When any ally triggers [Block], gain 25% Max HP of [Tenacity], can trigger 4 times.[Non-Crit DMG Free]: Effective for all types of DMG. Cannot co-exist with [Agility].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Gain 60% > 70% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. When any ally triggers [Block], gain 25% > 30% Max HP of [Tenacity], can trigger 4 times.[Non-Crit DMG Free]: Effective for all types of DMG. Cannot co-exist with [Agility].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Gain 60% > 80% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. When any ally triggers [Block], gain 25% > 35% Max HP of [Tenacity], can trigger 4 times.[Non-Crit DMG Free]: Effective for all types of DMG. Cannot co-exist with [Agility].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: [Basic Core] (Require: 1 Duelist, 1 Grappler, 1 Hi-Tech): Gain 3 energy per round.[Advanced Core] (Require: 1 of each): Permanently grants all allies [Specialized Resilience]. Before battle begins, all allies receive 150% Max HP of [Tenacity] (not affected by Shield Rate). At the start of battle, remove any Arena DMG Boost and Free effects from enemies.———— [Specialized Resilience]: Absorbs all types of DMG, accumulates up to 5x Max HP [Tenacity]; every 1 point of [Shield] absorbs 10 DMG, and Tenacity can recharge it. (Lv4: 180% Max HP / 11 DMG per Shield · Lv10: 210% Max HP / 12 DMG per Shield · Lv17: 250% Max HP / 13 DMG per Shield)

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: When any ally triggers [Block], grants 1 energy (once per turn). All characters gain 20% All DMG Boost and All DMG Free for 2 turns.

skills.name: Awaken 3 Passive
skills.desc: When any ally triggers [Block], grants 1 energy (twice per turn). All characters gain 20% All DMG Boost and All DMG Free for 2 turns.

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage up to a portion of the subject's Health; Charge DMG ignores it.
Reduces all non-critical damage (usually to 1). Cannot survive and avoid Agility.
Evasion type buff; mutually exclusive with Non-Crit Damage Immunity.
The absorption barrier, usually created from transmogrified damage, absorbs damage before health is affected.
